jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Northern Europe
jobs.description_text: Marketing Manager, Northern Europe Join Axon and be a Force for Good At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We partner with our customers on some of society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. We’re out to make the world a safer place by solving big problems and taking on the public safety challenges of our time. Your Impact This role offers a unique opportunity to join a dynamic team where your contributions will drive tangible, meaningful results for the business and the communities we serve in Northern Europe (Benelux and Nordics). You'll have the agility of working within a small, in-region sales and marketing team while benefiting from the resources and backing of a profitable, publicly traded company. As part of Axon’s centralized marketing function, you’ll collaborate closely across regions and departments to ensure consistent, high-impact initiatives. As the Marketing Manager, Northern Europe, you will be a key player on our Global Marketing team, focused on providing life-saving solutions to public safety and security agencies worldwide. jobs.description_text: As a Production Planner, you will be in charge of our operational production planning and ensuring a smooth production flow. This role plays a key part in delivery performance, capacity utilisation, and process optimisation through efficient scheduling, material availability checks, and close coordination with the Production Manager. Location : Kassel, Hesse Reports to : General Manager of Kassel Operations What You’ll Do Create and maintain production orders based on demand and capacity data. Check material availability in the system before order release. Book and track production orders in the ERP system. Analyse and address discrepancies between system and physical stock. Support operational purchasing based on predefined materials and suppliers. Coordinate closely with the Production Manager to align capacity and optimise resource planning. Identify and support resolution of material shortages. Evaluate and report lead times, order statuses, and production KPIs (e.g. delay causes). Key Responsibilities Production Planning: Manage and maintain production schedules aligned with demand and available capacity. Order Execution: Create, release, and track production orders in the ERP system. Material Coordination: Ensure material availability and resolve stock discrepancies in coordination with warehouse and purchasing. jobs.description_text: About the role: Cresta’s AI Receptionist answers the phone for small businesses that would otherwise miss the call. It handles millions of conversations a month today, making sure no call goes unanswered and helping owners complete the front-office tasks that keep their business running, and it does so across hundreds of customers. Whether those conversations are actually good is the single most important question in the business, and it deserves a full-time owner. That’s you. As our first AI Agent Evaluation Engineer, you define what quality means for every agent we run, you build the systems that measure it across every conversation, and you are the person the company trusts when the question is “how good is it, really?” The work combines hands-on conversation analysis, rigorous evaluation design, and engineering execution: reading and annotating real conversations to learn how the agent actually fails, building the automated evaluation systems (LLM-based judges, golden sets, regression suites) that measure those failures at scale, and keeping those systems honest by calibrating them against human judgment. Fixing what you find is welcome but not the core of the job; an accurate, prioritized picture of agent quality is. jobs.description_text: About the Role The overnight Transaction Reporting Analyst is a critical role responsible for the operational integrity of DriveWealth's regulatory trade reporting during the newly extended 24/5 equity trading session. This role works cross-functionally with Brokerage Operations, Compliance, and the U.S.-based Trade Reporting team. Review and manage the EBS (Electronic Blue Sheets) submission queue, escalating unresolved items to the U.S. team. Confirm successful completion of CAT (Consolidated Audit Trail) submissions, investigating and escalating failures. Prepare detailed end-of-shift reports summarizing exceptions, open items, and notable activity for the incoming U.S. team. jobs.title: Customer Reliability Engineer
jobs.description_text: Available Location: Singapore Why This Role Exists Cloudflare built its reputation helping build a better Internet, defending millions of sites, giving away SSL and DDoS mitigation when the industry charged premium prices. In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission. Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network. The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base. High-priority vulnerabilities rarely fit within one team’s boundaries. A fix may require kernel expertise, changes across software dependencies and trust stores, fleet-wide deployment, customer-facing WAF protections, and investigation of prior exploitation. You will bring those efforts together, with clear ownership from initial disclosure through verified remediation. This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will recruit the team, establish its operating model, and build the tooling that makes response faster and more reliable. You will combine experienced human judgment with carefully evaluated AI-assisted workflows—not automate away accountability. What you’ll do Build and lead the team - Establish Zero Day Engineering’s charter, priorities, operating model, and partnerships across Cloudflare. - Recruit, develop, and lead engineers spanning vulnerability response, exposure analysis, mitigation, patching, artifact provenance, release coordination, and automation. - Build a sustainable incident-command rotation, clear escalation paths, and effective handoffs across teams and time zones. - Create a culture of technical depth, calm execution, blameless learning, and shared accountability. jobs.title: Model Operations Lead, AI Gateway
jobs.description_text: Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York City, NY | San Francisco, CA About AI Gateway AI inference is becoming core infrastructure. Every serious application will need access to many models across many providers, with reliability, observability, security, cost control, and routing built in from the start. AI Gateway is Cloudflare's bet that this layer belongs at the network edge: close to users, close to compute, and simple enough that a developer can adopt it with one API change. Developers using AI Gateway need answers to two questions. Is the model I'm calling working the way you say it does? And which model should I be using at all? You'll lead the models team that answers both. You'll start with model operations. That's the work behind every model in the catalog: provider integrations, capability testing, pricing and metering, capacity, security reviews, docs, health, and deprecations. Sometimes a launch needs to go live within minutes of a lab's announcement. Sometimes the right call is to hold it. Cloudflare is an infrastructure company at heart, so reliability and accuracy come first; speed comes from preparation and automation. Then you'll bring model intelligence online. That means turning what we learn from Gateway traffic into decisions for customers: capability maps, per-task rankings, auto-routing profiles that pick the right model for each request, evals and regression detection, and market intelligence developers can trust. This is a people-management role

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Certificate Authority
jobs.description_text: Available Locations: Austin or London About the Role TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel. That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side. As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically. Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today. As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosy

jobs.title: Senior Certificate Authority Architect

This role spans applied cryptography, Web PKI, distributed systems, security engineering, compliance, and Internet standards. It will help Cloudflare build a CA that operates safely at Internet scale while establishing a credible path from today's X.509 ecosystem toward post-quantum authentication using Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs). Mission Define and guide the end-to-end architecture of Cloudflare's public Certificate Authority: a high-assurance, highly available system capable of issuing conventional publicly trusted certificates at Cloudflare scale while supporting Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs) and the evolution toward a post-quantum Web PKI. You will help determine not only how the CA is implemented, but also its trust boundaries, key hierarchy, issuance architecture, auditability, failure modes, incident response mechanisms, and long-term cryptographic evolution. Key Responsibilities Define and maintain the end-to-end technical architecture of Cloudflare's public CA across certificate issuance, key management, transparency, revocation, renewal, and relying-party integration. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
jobs.description_text: Locations: Austin, Lisbon, San Francisco, NYC, or London About the Role Search is being rebuilt around AI. People increasingly get answers from AI instead of a list of links, agents run dozens of searches to answer a single question, and more than half of the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated . Search is shifting from a destination to a utility, and Cloudflare is building the search layer for this agentic Internet. Agentic Search at Cloudflare gives agents everything they need to find information, whether it lives in a customer’s own data or on the open web. It spans two products: AI Search for internal data, and Web Search API for the open web. AI Search (internal data), now generally available , is the search primitive for applications and agents . It is a fully managed indexing and retrieval pipeline built on Workers AI , Vectorize , R2 , and Browser Run . Developers connect a website or R2 bucket, or upload their own files, and query them with natural language through a Workers binding, REST API, or MCP server. Under the hood: continuous indexing, hybrid vector and keyword retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, native multimodal (image) embeddings, and OCR for scanned documents. We use it to power search on our own blog and developer docs. Web Search API (external data), now in open beta , gives agents real-time web context with a single API call. It runs on AI Gateway , so every search gets the same logging, analytics, billing, and access controls

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Observability
jobs.description_text: Available Locations: London, New York City, Denver, Lisbon, Seattle, or Austin About the Role Millions of websites, applications, APIs, and AI agents run on Cloudflare, and the traffic we handle for them produces a lot of data. Some customers want to debug applications and investigate security events in Cloudflare. Others want that data in a stack they already trust, such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or their own data lake. Many want both. We're hiring one Senior Product Manager for each of two areas. You apply once, and we'll work out together which role fits you best. Observability Platform brings logs, traces, analytics, alerts, and dashboards together in one place, so customers can see what's happening and why. Today most observability ends with a notification, and the customer does the rest. We want a platform that understands the problem, takes action where it can, and asks before doing anything risky. Telemetry Export delivers Cloudflare's data to the tools customers choose. Logpush handles most of that delivery today, and Workers Observability sends logs and traces over the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP). Customers want OTLP for the rest of Cloudflare's data, metrics pushed to their own tools, and a way to send us telemetry from workloads that run elsewhere. Your mission is to make reliability and security something customers rarely have to worry about, with the data they need in Cloudflare or in the tools they already use. jobs.description_text: Available Locations: Austin, London, or San Francisco (Hybrid) About the team Search engines spent two decades learning what the web is worth: which pages are fresh, which sources are trusted, what people actually use. That knowledge came from watching how humans moved through the web. Agents break that loop. AI models are trained and grounded on the web, but they have little visibility into what's changed, what's authoritative, or what's been fabricated. Site owners have it worse: AI crawlers already request content anywhere from a hundred to tens of thousands of times for every visitor they send back, and most have no idea how, or whether, they show up in AI answers. Both sides of the market are flying blind. Cloudflare sits in front of around 20% of the web and sees both sides of that exchange. Our team, the Agentic Internet team, is focused on making the web readable, discoverable, callable, and payable, built on open standards so no single company owns the rails. Signals & Data Products turns our network's view into products both sides can use: helping AI labs know what's fresh and trustworthy, and helping site owners see and shape how they show up in AI. Cloudflare believes in the open Internet, and we're in a position to help build the future where it thrives. Come help us make it happen! You can read more about some of our plans here and here . jobs.description_text: Available Locations: Austin, TX About the DNS team Cloudflare runs one of the largest DNS infrastructures in the world. We provide authoritative DNS for millions of Internet properties and operate 1.1.1.1, a public recursive resolver. Aggregated our authoritative DNS and resolver platforms handle around 3 trillion DNS queries per day. Our DNS systems are custom built internally, so we’ve developed a lot of proprietary technology that operates at scale, iterating constantly to meet new scaling and reliability requirements. The work spans protocol implementation, distributed systems, performance, reliability, and the operational tooling behind them. Our team builds and operates both services, plus the systems that publish records, distribute changes, and serve queries across Cloudflare's global network.
